read.thesis: Q3 sales $1.47B missed the ~$1.65B guide and FY26 revenue was cut to $5.4-5.5B from $6.0-6.2B, with a $145M customer destock in Q4; FCF of $622M held up.

triggers.label: FY26 EPS cut to $3.70-3.80
triggers.quote: Adjusted diluted EPS in the range of $3.70 to $3.80 compared to previous guidance of $4.65 to $4.75

triggers.label: Retail destock ~$100M in Q4
triggers.quote: Approximately $145 million with $45 million in wholesale and $100 million in retail reflecting lower than anticipated customer replenishment as customers manage working capital levels.

triggers.label: Fleece POS down mid-high teens in Sept
triggers.quote: Fleece Point-of-Sale Trends -- Down mid to high teens in September, driven by unseasonably warm temperatures
triggers.highlight: Down mid to high teens in September

triggers.label: Mgmt sees room for further price rises
triggers.quote: there is probably room for more price increases for people to be able to, not just us, but the whole world, to absorb these higher costs.

triggers.label: 2026-28 objectives withdrawn
triggers.quote: we believe it is prudent to withdraw our previously communicated objectives for the 2028-2020 period

guidance.quote: Revenue is expected to be in the range of $5.4 billion to $5.5 billion compared to previous guidance of the low end of $6.0 billion to $6.2 billion
Adjusted diluted EPS in the range of $3.70 to $3.80 compared to previous guidance of $4.65 to $4.75
free cash flow to be $700 million to $750 million compared to previous guidance of approximately $1 billion
Full year adjusted operating margin of approximately 20% compared to previous guidance of approximately 21.8%
We remain on track to generate approximately $100 million targeted synergies for 2026.
we continue to expect approximately $250 million annual run-rate cost synergies by the end of 28.
CapEx to come in at approximately 3% of net sales
we expect to return to within our net leverage target framework by the end of 2027.
The adjusted effective income tax rate for 2026 is expected to be approximately 16%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Our sales came in below our guidance of approximately $1.65 billion
Adjusted operating margin was 27% of net sales, up 380 basis points versus last year and 100 basis points ahead of our guidance of approximately 26%.
we believe it is prudent to withdraw our previously communicated objectives for the 2028-2020 period

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 revenue, EPS, FCF, operating margin
prior_guidance_check.quote: Revenue is expected to be in the range of $5.4 billion to $5.5 billion compared to previous guidance

red_flags.label: Guidance cut ~40% on EPS, multiyear targets withdrawn
red_flags.quote: Management withdrew previously communicated objectives for the 2026 to 2028 period

red_flags.label: Retail customers curtailing weeks of supply
red_flags.quote: customers curtailing their weeks of supply amid you know, the environment

red_flags.label: Leverage above target at 2.7x
red_flags.quote: Net debt leverage ratio -- 2.7 times at the end of the third quarter

evasions.quote: John, we do not provide that information, right, in terms of a monthly breakdown and POS by category.
At this juncture, we are not providing guidance for 2027.
